ui.glossary.actText: One of the three big steps of a run: spec, plan, implementation.
ui.glossary.consentText: A human decision: GO plan, GO implement, CP (commit and push), READY (a draft PR ready for review).
ui.glossary.debtText: A matter consciously postponed, written in the plan or in the retrospective.
ui.glossary.etaText: The estimated end of the current operation given by the agent in a progress report.
ui.glossary.phaseText: A group of steps in the plan; done when all its steps are done.
ui.glossary.resultText: The Result section of the plan: what was actually done, with the checks and the deviations.
ui.glossary.stageText: A tile in an act; a pulsing dot marks the stage that is going on now.
ui.glossary.stepText: One item of the Progress list in the plan with an identifier, e.g. F1.2.
ui.glossary.title: Concepts
ui.glossary.verifyText: Steps reported as done but not yet ticked in the plan; the lighter shade of the bar.

ui.history.copiesTip: The same file (the same sha) is in the tabs: {tabs}. A status change applies only to the copy in tab {owner}.
ui.history.abandonedTip: An approved plan without progress: no step is checked, there is no local run and the file has not changed for over 14 days. It can be abandoned (status "archived").
ui.history.noAction: There is no status change for this plan.
ui.history.viewerOnly: The status can be changed only on the consent page; this page is read-only.
ui.history.truncated: The list is cut by the limits of the server (200 plans per tab, 1000 rows); older plans are not shown here.
ui.history.previewEmpty: Pick a plan from the list to see its preview.
ui.history.previewError: The plan could not be loaded: {error}
ui.history.confirmArchiveBody: Plan "{title}" (tab {tab}) changes its status from `done` to `archived`. Only the "Status" line changes; the audit gets a row with the time, the tab and the sha of the file `{sha}`.
ui.history.confirmUnarchiveBody: Plan "{title}" (tab {tab}) changes its status from `archived` to `done`. Only the "Status" line changes; the audit gets a row with the time, the tab and the sha of the file `{sha}`.
ui.history.confirmWarn: Note: changing the "Status" line of a tracked file makes `git status` of this worktree dirty and may conflict on merge; the audit lives in the directory of the tab and goes with a removed worktree.
ui.history.confirmCopies: The copies of this plan in other tabs ({tabs}) do not change.
ui.history.auditFailedTitle: The status of plan {title} was changed, but the audit was not written.
ui.history.auditFailedBody: Check the `.skillsync/audit` directory of tab {tab}: the `done` audit row was not created.
ui.history.confirmAbandonBody: Plan "{title}" (tab {tab}) changes its status from `approved` to `archived` and gets the "Porzucony" (abandoned) line with today's date (UTC); "Restore" undoes both. The audit gets a row with the time, the tab and the sha of the file `{sha}`.
ui.history.confirmRestoreApprovedBody: The abandoned plan "{title}" (tab {tab}) changes its status from `archived` to `approved` and loses the "Porzucony" (abandoned) line. The audit gets a row with the time, the tab and the sha of the file `{sha}`.
ui.history.failedTitle: The status of plan {title} was not changed.
ui.history.networkTitle: The status change of plan {title} was not confirmed.
ui.history.err.approvalsOff: The server runs without consents (`--no-approvals`): the status of a plan cannot be changed.
ui.history.err.badRequest: The server refused the request as malformed.
ui.history.err.planGone: The plan no longer exists in this tab. The list is being read again.
ui.history.err.shaMismatch: The plan changed since you saw it. Nothing was written; the list is being read again.
ui.history.err.statusNotAllowed: This change is not possible for the current status of the plan. The list is being read again.
ui.history.err.tabChanged: The worktree of the tab changed or was excluded. Nothing was written.
ui.history.err.locked: The plan is being changed by another write right now. Try again in a moment.
ui.history.err.tabGone: The worktree of this tab was removed. Nothing was written.
ui.history.err.auditRefused: The audit could not be written, so the status of the plan was not changed.
ui.history.err.network: No connection to the server. It is not known whether the change was saved; refresh the list.
ui.history.err.notAbandoned: This plan no longer meets the definition of an abandoned one. The list is being read again.
ui.history.err.other: The server refused the status change (HTTP {status}).
ui.tests.cmdFailed: exit code {exit}, no test reported a failure
ui.tests.cmdFailedTip: exit code {exit}, no test reported a failure (an exception outside the reported tests); the ok results cover only the tests that managed to run
ui.tests.groupError: Could not fetch the list of tests of this group.
ui.tests.groupsNote: Showing {shown} of {total} groups (failed and running first); the counters above cover all tests.
ui.tests.levelTip: test list = names and states of single tests (from a JUnit/TRX report or from a stream); counters = numbers only (e.g. "Executed N of M"); command = only the state of the command, no test results; "no running state" = the tool prints a test only after it ends, so until then the test is waiting
ui.tests.liveCompletion: (results after each test ends, no "running" state)
ui.tests.publicRaw: You are reading without signing in: the test results are raw, exactly what the tests printed (they may hold paths, addresses and secrets). Only the setting `tests.mask: on` masks them.
ui.tests.showTip: Show the tests of the step
ui.tests.skippedNote: Skipped {count} {noun} of test results (they could not be taken into account): {shown}{more}.
ui.tests.unreadable: Could not read the test results.
ui.timing.title: Work and waiting time
ui.timing.windowUnknown: (window unknown: no approval and no next checkpoint)
ui.toTop.aria: Back to the top of the page
ui.viewer.readOnly: Approvals are given by the host on the computer with the session.
ui.wait.givenAction: The approval "{word}" is already in the file; type "continue" in the session if the session has not started yet.
ui.wait.sessionWaiting: The session is waiting for you
ui.wait.vanishDefault: The banner will go away when the session starts.
ui.wait.vanishSilence: It will go away after the next report.
ui.wait.vanishWriting: It will go away when the agent finishes writing or the marker expires.
ui.waitSource.checkpoint: the "waiting:" marker in the last checkpoint
ui.waitSource.expert: open blocking questions to the expert
ui.waitSource.silence: time since the last line of checkpoints.md (threshold from the server)
